subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I am scared of snakes; likewise, you are ________ of lizards.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fearful"** means feeling afraid or showing fear; full of fear. (डरपोक)

 
 
• **Example:** She was** fearful** of the dark and always kept a light on at night.
 
 
 
• **"fearful"** refers to being afraid of something, similar to how someone can be scared of snakes. (डरपोक)
 
 
• **Example:** He is **fearful** of heights and avoids tall buildings.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **fearful.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Passionate** (उत्साही): Having or showing strong feelings or a strong belief.

 
 
• **Example:** She is** passionate **about painting and spends hours at her canvas.
 
 
 
• **Critical** (आलोचनात्मक): Expressing adverse or disapproving comments or judgments.
 
 
• **Example:** He is** critical **of every decision made by the management.
 
 
 
• **Fond** (प्रेमी): Having an affection or liking for.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very **fond** of children and enjoys spending time with them.
